definitions.gloss: mail order; online shopping; distance selling
definitions.explanation: Abbreviated form of {通信販売|つうしんはんばい} (distance selling). Originally referred to catalog-based mail order, but now primarily refers to online shopping through websites and apps.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通販|つうはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しか⟦{買|か}えない→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: This product can only be purchased through online shopping.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通販|つうはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食料品|しょくりょうひん}→食料品：01439_shokuryouhin⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{届|とど}けて→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: Lately, you can even get groceries delivered through online shopping, so I go out to shop less often.

notes:
USAGE:
Short for ⟦{通信販売|つうしんはんばい}→通信販売：22846_tsuushinhanbai⟧. In modern Japanese, {通販|つうはん} almost always refers to online shopping through websites like Amazon or Rakuten. The full form ⟦{通信販売|つうしんはんばい}→通信販売：22846_tsuushinhanbai⟧ sounds more formal and is used in legal or business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通販|つうはん}⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧ (online shopping site)
- {通販|つうはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy online)
- {通販|つうはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧ (to arrive via online order)
- ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧{通販|つうはん} (TV shopping)
- ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧{通販|つうはん} (internet shopping)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ネットショッピング→ネットショッピング：29757_nettoshoppingu⟧: online shopping — borrowed English term, same meaning
- ⟦{通信販売|つうしんはんばい}→通信販売：22846_tsuushinhanbai⟧: distance selling — the unabbreviated, more formal form
